'''April 1999 Portsmouth tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament played on 11 April 1999 at Portsmouth. [[Rod Latham]] finished 2nd of 14.<ref name="tourneys">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm My Tournament Reports], Rod Latham, [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001204191500/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lst10">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/lst10.htm Maelstrom], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319195003/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/lst10.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dst10">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/dst10.htm Pacific Blue Variant], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228073110/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/dst10.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 11 April 1999
* '''Site:''' Portsmouth
* '''Winner:''' Unknown

== Dating ==

Both decks are dated 11 April 1999 and their records add up to 5–1, matching this event on Latham's results page.
